story.iWant: a Task data model and Redux slice
story.tasks: - [ ] Task 1: Define Task interface (AC: 1) - [ ] Create comprehensive Task interface - [ ] Include all required properties (id, title, description, completed, timestamps) - [ ] Add optional fields for future features - [ ] Ensure TypeScript compatibility - [ ] Task 2: Create tasksSlice with reducers (AC: 2) - [ ] Set up createSlice with initial state - [ ] Implement basic reducers (add, update, delete, toggle) - [ ] Configure slice exports - [ ] Test reducer functionality - [ ] Task 3: Implement async thunks for CRUD (AC: 3) - [ ] Create async thunk for adding tasks - [ ] Create async thunk for updating tasks - [ ] Create async thunk for deleting tasks - [ ] Integrate with database operations - [ ] Task 4: Create selectors for queries (AC: 4) - [ ] Implement selectAllTasks selector - [ ] Implement selectIncompleteTasks selector - [ ] Implement selectCompletedTasks selector - [ ] Create selectors for specific task queries - [ ] Task 5: Implement optimistic updates (AC: 5) - [ ] Add optimistic updates to reducers - [ ] Handle rollback on failure - [ ] Ensure UI feels responsive - [ ] Test optimistic update scenarios - [ ] Task 6: Add error handling (AC: 6) - [ ] Handle database operation failures - [ ] Implement error states in slice - [ ] Provide user feedback on errors - [ ] Test error scenarios - [ ] Task 7: Manage loading states (AC: 7) - [ ] Add loading states to slice - [ ] Implement pending/fulfilled/rejected states - [ ] Update UI based on loading states - [ ] Test loading state management - [ ] Testing Tasks - [ ] Write unit tests for Task interface - [ ] Test slice reducers - [ ] Test async thunks - [ ] Test selectors functionality

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Task interface defined with all properties 2. tasksSlice created with reducers 3. Async thunks for CRUD operations 4. Selectors for common queries 5. Optimistic updates implemented 6. Error handling for failed operations 7. Loading states managed
